seams_remediated_in_this_slice.description: Index digest now verified via compute_index_tree_digest() comparison before git diff check. Mismatch produces prepared_index_changed refusal. Test evidence: test_bound_validate_refuses_when_index_tampered_after_preparation now asserts refusal.

Exception handler now fails closed: returns (None, None, ('refused', 'preparation_binding_error', ...)) instead of (None, None, None). Any runtime error in binding check prevents validation. Test evidence: test_bound_validate_fails_closed_when_storage_unreadable now asserts refusal.

Branch binding added: verifies receipt branch matches git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD. Worktree_root binding added: verifies receipt worktree_root matches git rev-parse --show-toplevel. Mismatch produces preparation_branch_mismatch or preparation_worktree_mismatch refusal.

slice_1.title: Canonical receipt-store authority and integrity semantics
slice_1.description: Consolidate preparation receipt persistence/loading behind receipt_store with typed failure outcomes. Add digest integrity verification on load. Keep temporary delegating imports in auth_receipts during migration.
key_deliverables: receipt_store: typed LoadResult distinguishing absent, unreadable, corrupt_json, schema_invalid, integrity_mismatch, loaded_valid
receipt_store: digest integrity check on load (recompute canonical receipt digest, compare with receipt_sha256)
auth_receipts: convert load/persist_preparation_receipt into delegators to receipt_store during migration
All callers migrate to receipt_store for persistence/loading
Tests: typed outcome proof for each failure mode with real receipt files

slice_2.title: Immutable lifecycle events
slice_2.description: Append-only lifecycle event ledger referencing immutable preparation receipt SHA. Never rewrite receipt files.
key_deliverables: Lifecycle event schema: event_type (consumed, superseded, revoked), preparation_receipt_sha256, branch, worktree_root, committed_head, timestamp, producer, integrity_digest
Read-side projection: fold lifecycle events by receipt SHA, filter out receipts with terminal events
checkpoint.py: emit consumed event recoverable from terminal checkpoint receipt
prepare_checkpoint.py: supersede conflicting-scope or explicitly-replaced receipts
Crash recovery: terminal checkpoint receipt authoritatively proves consumption; repair missing consumed event on restart

slice_3.title: Replay-proof adversarial exercise
slice_3.description: Exercise full prepare→validate→checkpoint replay through real temporary Git repositories.
key_deliverables: Consumption replay: prepare → checkpoint → recreate index → re-validate → assert preparation_receipt_consumed refusal
Supersession: prepare A → prepare conflicting B → assert A superseded, only B valid for checkpoint
Non-conflicting parallel scope: prepare A + B on disjoint paths, same branch → both active
Crash recovery: commit-success + consume-write-failure → terminal checkpoint receipt provides recovery

observable_input_policy_convergence.description: validate.py now delegates ignored-input classification to classify_ignored_observable_inputs from rig_relay.core.observable_input_policy. Inline classification tuples and for-loop logic replaced. Policy module uses directory-component matching (Path.parents) instead of string-prefix matching. Extension matching extended to include name-based checks.
